title: Alpha Arbutin Cream: What It Does for Dark Spots and How to Use It
ex: Alpha arbutin is a gentle ingredient for dark spots and uneven patches. Learn how it works, how to use it with sunscreen, and how it compares with kojic acid.
rt: Alpha Arbutin Cream: Uses for Dark Spots | Mirc Glow
rd: Alpha arbutin cream explained: how it helps dark spots look less noticeable, how to use it with sunscreen, who should take care, and vs kojic acid.
quick: An alpha arbutin cream helps dark spots and uneven patches look less noticeable by slowing new pigment, not by changing your natural skin colour. Use a pea-sized amount at night over the whole face, wear sunscreen every morning, and expect a more even look over 8 to 12 weeks.
facts: Alpha arbutin is a stable form of arbutin, found in plants such as bearberry.
Face creams usually use it at up to about 2%.
It is usually gentler than kojic acid on sensitive skin.
Daily sunscreen is essential for any spot-focused cream.
